itens.trecho: Uma sequela discreta mas positiva. Este filme é uma sequela de "Silêncio dos Inocentes" e tem uma história muito semelhante: com um novo assassino em série, o FBI novamente solicitará a ajuda do perigoso e manipulador Hannibal Lecter, o canibal mais famoso de todos os tempos.

I am not a man. I began as one, but now I am becoming more than a man, as you will witness. Red Dragon is based on the novel of the same name written by Thomas Harris and is directed by Brett Ratner and written by Ted Tally. It stars Edward Norton, Anthony Hopkins, Ralph Fiennes, Emily Watson, Harvey Keitel, Mary-Louise Parker & Phillip Seymour Hoffman.

Retired FBI man "Will Graham" (Ed Norton) finds himself back working with "Hannibal Lecter" (Sir Anthony Hopkins) at whose hands, years earlier, he only narrowly escaped death - this time on the hunt for the elusive "Tooth Fairy" (Ralph Fiennes) who is running amok in downtown Baltimore using each full moon as an excuse to slaughter two - seemingly…
